descriptionChirho: Basic adjectival sense denoting small physical size, low quantity, or insignificance, used both attributively and predicatively with or without the article.

Comparative or superlative sense indicating the younger or youngest member (especially of a family) or the least in rank or status, confirmed by Arabic elative أَصْغَر and Spanish 'menor' across translations.
Used with preposition מִן in the formulaic expression 'from the least to the greatest', denoting the lower bound of an inclusive social or age range.
